product: Ethan Lee Barrett public-work catalogue on povvo.github.io/povvo: a finder for about sixty repositories
audience: Recruiters, collaborators and curious developers arriving from GitHub on laptops and phones for a few minutes
decision_owner: Ethan Lee Barrett (direction drafted in this build; approval pending his review)
visual_thesis: Because visitors arrive at sixty projects by one person with no idea which matter, organise the work as a single physical collection, cases with printed spines and inserts on a revolving rack, set into a quiet typeset catalogue page, so that scale reads at a glance, the chosen project reads as singular, and reading the README feels like turning a case over in the hand rather than scrolling a feed.
perceptual_goals: Orientation: one person's collection, catalogued; masthead carries name, subtitle and count
Selection: the front case is the current one; it is the only extracted object and the only accented index line
Relation: neighbouring spines show order; the index mirrors rack order; the catalogue number ties both
Interpretation: printed inserts under a glossy sleeve read as authored objects; the still page reads as edited
Reward: opening the case, the disc, the small print on the insert

anti_targets.name: PS2 cosplay
anti_targets.failure_signature: Blue void, cube icons, console boot cues; the page reads as an emulator rather than a person's catalogue

anti_targets.name: Dark portfolio default
anti_targets.failure_signature: Near-black page, glowing accent, cursor trail, grain, marquee; another developer could ship it unchanged

anti_targets.name: Spec-Scan carry-over
anti_targets.failure_signature: Cyan line accents, condensed sans plus mono instrument look, scanlines, the aperture P

anti_targets.name: Carousel theatre
anti_targets.failure_signature: Rack spins dramatically on every change, idle motion with hands off, parallax on scroll, selection settles slower than half a second

anti_targets.name: Cover art soup
anti_targets.failure_signature: Gradient, blob and noise covers compete with titles; spines unreadable at rest

anti_targets.name: Reading inside the texture
anti_targets.failure_signature: README rendered as a canvas texture: blurry, unscrollable, invisible to assistive technology

routes.name: A. The Drum
routes.governing_relationship: Object dominates, type annotates: a helical revolving rack fills the stage; rotation selects; the front case extracts and hinges open; the page is a quiet catalogue sheet
routes.tradeoff: WebGL and GPU cost for sixty textured cases; a non-WebGL equivalent must exist
routes.falsification_test: A mid-range phone drops below about 45 fps while turning, or spine titles are unreadable at rest on a 1366-wide laptop

routes.name: B. The Index
routes.governing_relationship: Type dominates, one object illustrates: a long typographic index is the hero; focusing a line summons that one case into a fixed window
routes.tradeoff: The rack idea disappears; the sense of a collection as one object is lost; cheapest and most accessible
routes.falsification_test: The page reads as a plain list with a decorative 3D widget and passes competitor reassignment unchanged

routes.name: C. The Shelf
routes.governing_relationship: Camera dominates, objects are scenery: a literal shelf runs across a room; scroll dollies the camera; the hovered case pulls out and the camera pushes in
routes.tradeoff: Horizontal travel fights phones; sixty cases is a long walk; camera travel is the largest vestibular risk
routes.falsification_test: A visitor cannot reach item 47 within a few seconds, or reduced motion removes the navigation model

signature_patterns.name: The extraction
signature_patterns.governing_relationship: The current case is the only object that leaves the rack, travelling along its outward normal with a slight rise and a quarter turn to show the cover
signature_patterns.recurrence_rule: Triggered when rack angular velocity settles with a case at the front; never on hover; at most one case out at any time
signature_patterns.variation_rule: Travel distance scales with viewport; under reduced motion it becomes a crossfade of a flat rendition
signature_patterns.failure_signature: Extraction on hover, two cases out, cases that bob or never settle

signature_patterns.name: The catalogue number as key
signature_patterns.governing_relationship: The accession number (order of repository creation) ties the spine, insert, index line and booklet header
signature_patterns.recurrence_rule: Printed on exactly those four surfaces and nowhere else; no other numbers in the chrome
signature_patterns.variation_rule: Three digits until the collection passes 999; typeset tabular in the grotesk
signature_patterns.failure_signature: Stars, forks and dates competing with the number as badges

exceptions.reason: The index is locked as always-present even though route A is object-led, because finding speed and accessibility floor come from route B
exceptions.scope: Wide viewports show both columns; reduced motion and no-WebGL make the index primary
exceptions.return_condition: Revisit if a user study shows the index is ignored on wide viewports
